title: Label the required setlist name
prompt:
In lib/screens/setlists/create_setlist_screen.dart, replace this exact block:
```dart
                      Expanded(
                        child: TextFormField(
                          controller: _nameController,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(
                            labelText: 'Setlist Name *',
                            prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.queue_music),
                          ),
                          textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                          onChanged: (_) => _markAsChanged(),
                          validator: (v) => (v == null || v.trim().isEmpty)
                              ? 'Required'
                              : null,
                        ),
                      ),
```
with:
```dart
                      Expanded(
                        child: Semantics(
                          label: 'Setlist Name, required',
                          child: TextFormField(
                            controller: _nameController,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Setlist Name *',
                              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.queue_music),
                            ),
                            textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                            onChanged: (_) => _markAsChanged(),
                            validator: (v) => (v == null || v.trim().isEmpty)
                                ? 'Required'
                                : null,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
```
Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.

title: Expose event details toggle state
prompt:
In lib/screens/setlists/create_setlist_screen.dart, replace this exact block:
```dart
                      IconButton(
                        tooltip: _showEventDetails
                            ? 'Hide event details'
                            : 'Show event details',
                        icon: Icon(
                          _showEventDetails
                              ? Icons.expand_less
                              : Icons.expand_more,
                          color: context.mp.textSecondary,
                        ),
                        onPressed: () => setState(
                          () => _showEventDetails = !_showEventDetails,
                        ),
                      ),
```
with:
```dart
                      Semantics(
                        expanded: _showEventDetails,
                        child: IconButton(
                          tooltip: _showEventDetails
                              ? 'Hide event details'
                              : 'Show event details',
                          icon: Icon(
                            _showEventDetails
                                ? Icons.expand_less
                                : Icons.expand_more,
                            color: context.mp.textSecondary,
                          ),
                          onPressed: () => setState(
                            () => _showEventDetails = !_showEventDetails,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
```
The existing tooltip supplies the toggle's action label; the Semantics widget supplies its expanded state. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
